name: rpdp
title: Repeat Photo Data Profile
description: Fixed-point repeat photography for temporal change. Extends the land profile with an alignments resource and a stable locationID across visits.
rules: Every deployment used for comparison MUST set fixedPoint=true.
Revisits of the same stake MUST reuse the same locationID.
cameraHeading, cameraTilt, and focalLength SHOULD be recorded so later visits can match framing.
When two frames are registered, add an alignments row rather than overwriting media.
